name: Aes67MediaIDType
comment: Type of MediaID used to select a Media Description within an SDP string for ConfigureEndpointFromSDP(...).

enumerators.name: None
enumerators.comment: Media ID type is not specified. Allowed when the SDP string contains exactly one Media Description.

enumerators.name: Ordinal
enumerators.comment: Media Description position (1-n) in the Session Descriptor. Numeric value in string format.

enumerators.name: PortNo
enumerators.comment: Media Stream's UDP port number. Numeric value in string format.

enumerators.name: TransportAddress4
enumerators.comment: Media Stream's IPv4 address + UDP port number, as IPv4address:portnumber.

enumerators.name: TransportAddress6
enumerators.comment: IPv6 address + UDP port number as [IPv6address]:portnumber. Included for future use; not used for AES67, which does not support IPv6.
